title: Can the unseen child change the choice?
hook: A branch can stop mattering before every leaf has been read.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Prune a minimax branch when its alpha-beta bounds cannot change an ancestor's decision.

misconception: Every leaf must be evaluated to guarantee a minimax choice.
objective: Prune a minimax branch when its alpha-beta bounds cannot change an ancestor's decision.

claims.text: A MIN child at or below the current MAX guarantee cannot improve the root decision. Its remaining leaf is skipped. Reordering children changes which bounds arrive first, so the same minimax value can require a different number of evaluations.
